name: @flui-cloud/vops
description: Local-first, real-time VPS provider comparison and safe provisioning using provider APIs.
author: Flui <hello@flui.cloud>

scripts.postbuild: node scripts/build-map.js && node scripts/build-agent-kit.js && node scripts/build-ui.js && pnpm link --global
scripts.prepack: tsc && tsc-alias && node scripts/build-map.js && node scripts/build-agent-kit.js && node scripts/build-ui.js
scripts.sonar:loop: pnpm run sonar:scan && pnpm run sonar:report

providers.description: Research and compare cloud providers (capabilities, prices, availability)

agent.description: Governed coding-agent setup, sessions, approvals and operations

mcp.description: Local vOps MCP server over stdio or authenticated loopback HTTP

remote.description: Outbound-only encrypted remote control, pairing and device governance

knowledge.description: Search and read the canonical vOps agent knowledge kit

capability.description: Inspect the authoritative semantic capability registry

spec.description: flui.yaml: framework templates, deterministic generation, schema validation

catalog.description: Browse what can be deployed: packaged products and reusable building blocks

build.description: Build the application image on GitHub Actions (vops never builds locally or on the VPS)

deploy.description: Immutable plan, explicit approval, apply, verify

config.description: Local encrypted provider credentials (tokens stay on this machine)

keyring.description: Passphrase-derived vault for local secrets (the key is derived, never stored)

service.description: Always-on local service: the dashboard and metrics collector, started for you

servers.description: Plan and safely provision VPS resources (hourly-billed only)

firewall.description: Manage cloud firewalls: rules, targets (idempotent with the dashboard)

vnet.description: Manage private networks: subnets, routes, server attachments

ssh-key.description: Local SSH keys (private stays on this machine) + provider upload

watch.description: Get notified when you're away: plan stock/price, uptime, and host silence

watch:plan.description: Watch a plan and get pushed when it comes back in stock or changes price

watch:uptime.description: External black-box uptime monitors (the hosted relay probes from outside)

watch:host.description: Dead-man's-switch monitor: cron + readable script, alerts on silence

host.description: Day-2 operations over SSH: inventory, live health status, hardening, updates, ops key

host:key.description: Manage the vops operations key on a host (install, revoke, status)

host:agent.description: Optional in-guest metrics agent (single static binary, sha256-verified)

bench.description: Measured performance per euro: a versioned benchmark battery over SSH + share artifact

backup.description: restic backups over SSH to any S3-compatible repo (verified binary, cron)

app.description: Deploy flui.yaml apps to a host over SSH (rootful Podman + Quadlet, no agent)

ingress.description: Per-host Traefik ingress: real hostnames + ACME TLS for deployed apps
